'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Senate v3.7
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
